title: 顆粒活性碳吸附~Granular activated-carbon adsorption
focus: 吸附平衡、床層傳質、穿透與再生~Adsorption equilibrium, bed transfer, breakthrough and regeneration
summary: 本課以吸附平衡、床層傳質、穿透與再生為主線，從目標物與競爭背景、批次等溫線、空床接觸時間、處理床體積數進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops adsorption equilibrium, bed transfer, breakthrough and regeneration through ten connected units, beginning with targets and competing background, batch adsorption isotherms, empty-bed contact time, treated bed volumes. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 目標物與競爭背景~Targets and competing background
units.mechanism: 辨識要控制的有機物、濃度單位及背景 DOC；不同目標物的吸附行為不能互相替代。~Identify target organics, concentration units and background DOC; adsorption behavior is not interchangeable among compounds.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=500 m³/d；目標物=20 µg/L。模型 L=QC/1000000，代入得到 0.01 kg/d。適用邊界：微克至公斤換算；不可把背景 DOC 當作同一種目標物。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=500 m³/d; target compound=20 µg/L. Model L=QC/1000000 gives 0.01 kg/d. Applicability: Microgram-to-kilogram conversion; background DOC is not the same target compound.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「目標物與競爭背景」的觀測點。採流量加權目標物樣本，保留分析檢出限與空白。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for targets and competing background. Collect flow-weighted target-compound samples with detection limits and blanks. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用總有機碳數字代替特定微量污染物。診斷與介入：核對微克換算與流量加權濃度，保留分析空白。~Total organic carbon substitutes for a specific trace contaminant. Diagnostic response: Check microgram conversion and flow-weighted concentration, retaining analytical blanks.
units.misconception: 所有有機物在活性碳上的親和力相同。~All organics have equal carbon affinity.
units.practice: 只改變 C:20→30 µg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.01 變為 0.015 kg/d。用「目標物與競爭背景」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:20→30 µg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.01 to 0.015 kg/d. Explain the direction using targets and competing background, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 批次等溫線~Batch adsorption isotherms
units.mechanism: 平衡試驗建立濃度與碳負載關係；擬合範圍外與多成分競爭需另外驗證。~Equilibrium tests relate concentration to carbon loading; extrapolation and multicomponent competition need separate validation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假想 K=2 (mg/g)/(mg/L)^0.5；C=0.10 mg/L；1/n=0.5。模型 q=K C^(1/n)，代入得到 0.63245553 mg/g。適用邊界：同溫度單溶質平衡擬合；不能直接預測多成分動態床壽命。~Original teaching assumptions: Hypothetical K=2 (mg/g)/(mg/L)^0.5; C=0.10 mg/L; 1/n=0.5. Model q=K C^(1/n) gives 0.63245553 mg/g. Applicability: Same-temperature single-solute equilibrium fit; it does not directly predict multisolute dynamic-bed life.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「批次等溫線」的觀測點。以平衡批次數據擬合並用未參與擬合的濃度點驗證。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for batch adsorption isotherms. Fit equilibrium batch data and validate with held-out concentration points. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 直接把單溶質平衡容量當動態床可用容量。診斷與介入：補測競爭背景與不同濃度，將平衡容量和動態壽命分開。~Single-solute equilibrium capacity is used as dynamic-bed capacity. Diagnostic response: Add competing-background/concentration tests and separate equilibrium capacity from dynamic life.
units.misconception: 等溫線能單獨給出實際換碳日期。~An isotherm alone provides the actual replacement date.
units.practice: 只改變 C:0.10→0.20 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.63245553 變為 0.89442719 mg/g。用「批次等溫線」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:0.10→0.20 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.63245553 to 0.89442719 mg/g. Explain the direction using batch adsorption isotherms, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 空床接觸時間~Empty-bed contact time
units.mechanism: EBCT 用總床體積除流量，便於比較接觸條件；它不是孔隙停留時間。~EBCT divides bulk bed volume by flow for comparison; it is not pore-water residence time.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空床體積=10 m³；Q=30 m³/h。模型 EBCT=60V/Q，代入得到 20 min。適用邊界：空床接觸時間不是孔隙水實際停留，更不保證吸附未突破。~Original teaching assumptions: Empty bed volume=10 m³; Q=30 m³/h. Model EBCT=60V/Q gives 20 min. Applicability: Empty-bed contact time is not actual pore residence or a guarantee against breakthrough.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「空床接觸時間」的觀測點。將床體積與累積床體積數、出口濃度一起觀察。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for empty-bed contact time. Track bed volume alongside cumulative bed volumes and outlet concentration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 在 EBCT 又乘孔隙率造成定義混亂。診斷與介入：確認使用總床體積定義，將短流與傳質效果另驗證。~Porosity is inserted into EBCT, confusing definitions. Diagnostic response: Confirm the bulk-bed-volume definition and validate bypass/mass transfer separately.
units.misconception: EBCT 與實際每個水粒子的接觸時間相同。~EBCT equals the actual contact time of every parcel.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:30→40 m³/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 20 變為 15 min。用「空床接觸時間」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:30→40 m³/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 20 to 15 min. Explain the direction using empty-bed contact time, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 處理床體積數~Treated bed volumes
units.mechanism: 累積處理量除床體積把不同規模試驗連結，但相同 BV 不代表相同污染負荷。~Cumulative volume divided by bed volume supports scale comparison, but equal BV does not imply equal contaminant load.
units.model: 原創教學假設：累積處理水=24000 m³；炭床=10 m³。模型 BV=Vwater/Vbed，代入得到 2400 bed volumes。適用邊界：床體積數只是通量指標；競爭吸附與進料濃度使壽命不同。~Original teaching assumptions: Cumulative throughput=24000 m³; carbon bed=10 m³. Model BV=Vwater/Vbed gives 2400 bed volumes. Applicability: Bed volumes quantify throughput only; competition and feed concentration change service life.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「處理床體積數」的觀測點。把 C/C0 對床體積數作突破曲線。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for treated bed volumes. Plot C/C0 against bed volumes as a breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 原水濃度改變仍用固定 BV 預測壽命。診斷與介入：同步畫累積床體積與污染質量，不只比較運轉日數。~A fixed BV life is used despite changed influent concentration. Diagnostic response: Plot cumulative bed volumes and contaminant mass together, not runtime alone.
units.misconception: 相同 BV 的碳床一定達到相同飽和程度。~Beds at equal BV always have equal saturation.
units.practice: 只改變 Vwater:24000→30000 m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2400 變為 3000 bed volumes。用「處理床體積數」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Vwater:24000→30000 m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2400 to 3000 bed volumes. Explain the direction using treated bed volumes, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 傳質區與穿透曲線~Mass-transfer zone and breakthrough curve
units.mechanism: 沿床深與時間的 C/C0 描述傳質區前進；出口單點不能看見整條曲線。~C/C0 versus depth/time describes the advancing mass-transfer zone; one outlet point does not reveal the whole curve.
units.model: 原創教學假設：入口 C0=100 µg/L；出口 C=10 µg/L。模型 B=C/C0，代入得到 0.1 fraction。適用邊界：相對突破不等於符合飲用水要求；還需絕對濃度及分析不確定度。~Original teaching assumptions: Inlet C0=100 µg/L; outlet C=10 µg/L. Model B=C/C0 gives 0.1 fraction. Applicability: Relative breakthrough does not establish potable-water compliance; absolute concentration and uncertainty matter.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「傳質區與穿透曲線」的觀測點。同時取入口、出口樣本，避免入口突變造成誤判。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for mass-transfer zone and breakthrough curve. Sample inlet/outlet together to avoid misreading feed changes. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只到出水明顯升高才建立第一筆資料。診斷與介入：檢查床前後同時採樣與檢出限，沿時間建立穿透曲線。~Monitoring starts only after a large effluent rise. Diagnostic response: Check simultaneous bed samples/detection limits and build a time-based breakthrough curve.
units.misconception: 穿透比例是獨立於原水濃度的飲水合格標準。~Breakthrough fraction is a drinking-water limit independent of inlet concentration.
units.practice: 只改變 C:10→25 µg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.1 變為 0.25 fraction。用「傳質區與穿透曲線」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:10→25 µg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.1 to 0.25 fraction. Explain the direction using mass-transfer zone and breakthrough curve, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 容量與質量保守估計~Capacity and mass-based estimates
units.mechanism: 以假想工作容量與負荷估算上限量級，再用中試穿透修正，避免把材料比表面積當容量。~Use hypothetical working capacity/loading for an order-of-magnitude estimate and refine with pilot breakthrough, not surface area alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：炭量=1000 kg；假設工作容量=0.02 kg/kg；去除負荷=0.5 kg/d。模型 t=Mq/L，代入得到 40 d。適用邊界：忽略傳質區與競爭吸附的容量上限式教學值。~Original teaching assumptions: Carbon=1000 kg; assumed working capacity=0.02 kg/kg; removed load=0.5 kg/d. Model t=Mq/L gives 40 d. Applicability: Capacity-based teaching bound neglecting mass-transfer zone and competing adsorption.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「容量與質量保守估計」的觀測點。使用小柱或現場突破資料校正工作容量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for capacity and mass-based estimates. Calibrate working capacity with small-column or field breakthrough data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以新碳名稱或表面積保證固定壽命。診斷與介入：用中試動態容量及競爭水質校正，規劃穿透前後的採樣。~A carbon label or surface area is used to guarantee life. Diagnostic response: Refine with pilot dynamic capacity/competing water quality and plan breakthrough sampling.
units.misconception: 廠商單一測試容量適用所有原水。~One material test capacity applies to every source water.
units.practice: 只改變 q:0.02→0.015 kg/kg，其餘假設固定；結果應由 40 變為 30 d。用「容量與質量保守估計」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only q:0.02→0.015 kg/kg, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 40 to 30 d. Explain the direction using capacity and mass-based estimates, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 多床串聯與採樣~Series beds and sampling
units.mechanism: 前後床分別採樣可觀察前床耗竭及後床保護，換床時仍需維持目標物證據。~Sampling each bed reveals lead-bed exhaustion and lag-bed protection; switching requires continued target-compound evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：入口 C0=100 µg/L；出口 C=10 µg/L。模型 B=C/C0，代入得到 0.1 fraction。適用邊界：相對突破不等於符合飲用水要求；還需絕對濃度及分析不確定度。~Original teaching assumptions: Inlet C0=100 µg/L; outlet C=10 µg/L. Model B=C/C0 gives 0.1 fraction. Applicability: Relative breakthrough does not establish potable-water compliance; absolute concentration and uncertainty matter.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「多床串聯與採樣」的觀測點。同時取入口、出口樣本，避免入口突變造成誤判。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for series beds and sampling. Sample inlet/outlet together to avoid misreading feed changes. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只量總出口而不知道前床何時穿透。診斷與介入：檢查床前後同時採樣與檢出限，沿時間建立穿透曲線。~Only final effluent is measured, hiding lead-bed breakthrough. Diagnostic response: Check simultaneous bed samples/detection limits and build a time-based breakthrough curve.
units.misconception: 有兩床就可省略中間採樣。~Two beds eliminate intermediate sampling.
units.practice: 只改變 C:10→25 µg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.1 變為 0.25 fraction。用「多床串聯與採樣」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:10→25 µg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.1 to 0.25 fraction. Explain the direction using series beds and sampling, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 生物活性與壓損~Biological activity and head loss
units.mechanism: 生物生長可能改變有機物去除與氧需求，也可能增加壓損；需分開吸附與生物作用的證據。~Biology can alter organic removal and oxygen demand while increasing head loss; distinguish biological and adsorptive evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：濾速 v=5 m/h；床深 L=0.8 m；假想水力傳導係數 K=5 m/h。模型 Δh=vL/K，代入得到 0.8 m。適用邊界：飽和、近似線性 Darcy 關係的教學例；堵塞、分層及非線性流動需另外描述。~Original teaching assumptions: Filtration velocity v=5 m/h; bed depth L=0.8 m; hypothetical hydraulic conductivity K=5 m/h. Model Δh=vL/K gives 0.8 m. Applicability: Teaching example of saturated near-linear Darcy flow; fouling, layering and nonlinear flow require additional description.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「生物活性與壓損」的觀測點。比較進出測壓管水頭並記錄水溫與流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for biological activity and head loss. Compare inlet/outlet piezometric heads and record temperature and flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 碳床出水改善全歸因仍有大量吸附容量。診斷與介入：比較分層測壓、流量與水溫，區分堵塞與流量變化。~Improved effluent is attributed only to unused adsorption capacity. Diagnostic response: Compare multi-level heads, flow and temperature to distinguish clogging from changed flow.
units.misconception: 生物活性代表不需要再關心穿透或衛生管理。~Biological activity eliminates breakthrough and hygiene concerns.
units.practice: 只改變 K:5→4 m/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 1 m。用「生物活性與壓損」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only K:5→4 m/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 1 m. Explain the direction using biological activity and head loss, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 換碳、再生與殘餘物~Replacement, regeneration and residuals
units.mechanism: 用目標物穿透、床層狀態及再生後驗證決定材料管理；污染物仍有處置去向。~Material management uses target breakthrough, bed condition and post-regeneration validation; captured contaminants still require a destination.
units.model: 原創教學假設：炭量=1000 kg；假設工作容量=0.02 kg/kg；去除負荷=0.5 kg/d。模型 t=Mq/L，代入得到 40 d。適用邊界：忽略傳質區與競爭吸附的容量上限式教學值。~Original teaching assumptions: Carbon=1000 kg; assumed working capacity=0.02 kg/kg; removed load=0.5 kg/d. Model t=Mq/L gives 40 d. Applicability: Capacity-based teaching bound neglecting mass-transfer zone and competing adsorption.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「換碳、再生與殘餘物」的觀測點。使用小柱或現場突破資料校正工作容量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for replacement, regeneration and residuals. Calibrate working capacity with small-column or field breakthrough data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 再生後僅看重量便宣稱全部性能恢復。診斷與介入：用中試動態容量及競爭水質校正，規劃穿透前後的採樣。~Recovered mass alone is used to claim restored performance. Diagnostic response: Refine with pilot dynamic capacity/competing water quality and plan breakthrough sampling.
units.misconception: 再生可保證原始吸附能力百分之百恢復。~Regeneration guarantees full restoration of original capacity.
units.practice: 只改變 q:0.02→0.015 kg/kg，其餘假設固定；結果應由 40 變為 30 d。用「換碳、再生與殘餘物」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only q:0.02→0.015 kg/kg, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 40 to 30 d. Explain the direction using replacement, regeneration and residuals, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 成效與資料可追溯~Performance and data traceability
units.mechanism: 把累積流量、進出濃度、檢出限及換碳時間對齊，區分真正去除與原水自然下降。~Align cumulative flow, inlet/outlet concentration, detection limits and replacement dates to distinguish removal from a declining influent.
units.model: 原創教學假設：累積處理水=24000 m³；炭床=10 m³。模型 BV=Vwater/Vbed，代入得到 2400 bed volumes。適用邊界：床體積數只是通量指標；競爭吸附與進料濃度使壽命不同。~Original teaching assumptions: Cumulative throughput=24000 m³; carbon bed=10 m³. Model BV=Vwater/Vbed gives 2400 bed volumes. Applicability: Bed volumes quantify throughput only; competition and feed concentration change service life.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「成效與資料可追溯」的觀測點。把 C/C0 對床體積數作突破曲線。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for performance and data traceability. Plot C/C0 against bed volumes as a breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只有出口曲線就宣稱材料效能提升。診斷與介入：同步畫累積床體積與污染質量，不只比較運轉日數。~An outlet curve alone is used to claim improved media performance. Diagnostic response: Plot cumulative bed volumes and contaminant mass together, not runtime alone.
units.misconception: 未檢出等於床層仍然完全未使用。~Nondetection means the bed remains completely unused.
units.practice: 只改變 Vwater:24000→30000 m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2400 變為 3000 bed volumes。用「成效與資料可追溯」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Vwater:24000→30000 m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2400 to 3000 bed volumes. Explain the direction using performance and data traceability, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
